comment: Book of Stray Minutes (canon section 2), page 1 of 12: mornings. Each text completes 'It was ___.' in config.collect.found_text. Bell has never seen a dawn, so this page is the one Bell would love.

reward.text: The Morning Minutes page is full, and it glows the pale gold of a sky just before the sun. Bell, who has never once seen a dawn, will want to hear every one of these.

do.text: {actor} has filled the Morning Minutes page of their Book of Stray Minutes: a whole page of small mornings, each with a sunrise somewhere in it.

collectibles.name: the first-light minute
collectibles.text: the grey minute before the birds agreed it was morning

collectibles.name: the warm-side minute
collectibles.text: one more minute on the warm side of the blankets, asked for and granted

collectibles.name: the frost-fern minute
collectibles.text: a fingertip tracing frost ferns on the inside of a bedroom window

collectibles.name: the dew minute
collectibles.text: footprints across a lawn gone silver with dew, the first of the day

collectibles.name: the doorstep minute
collectibles.text: bare feet on a cold doorstep, and the whole lane only just waking up

collectibles.name: the early-riser minute
collectibles.text: that first quiet stretch when the whole house slept but you, and the morning was yours alone

collectibles.name: the blackbird minute
collectibles.text: a blackbird on the gutter practising the same four notes until it got them right

collectibles.name: the curtain minute
collectibles.text: the moment the curtains were drawn back and the room filled up with yellow

collectibles.name: the stretching minute
collectibles.text: a morning stretch so enormous it ended in a small squeak

collectibles.name: the sunrise minute
collectibles.text: the sun lifting clear of the far hills while somebody held their breath to watch

collectibles.name: the mist minute
collectibles.text: sixty seconds of early mist, when the far fields had simply not arrived yet

collectibles.name: the odd-shoes minute
collectibles.text: halfway down the stairs in shoes that did not match, and not minding one bit

collectibles.name: the pillow-hair minute
collectibles.text: a first sleepy look at hair that had clearly had adventures in the night

collectibles.name: the cockerel minute
collectibles.text: a cockerel who crowed once, thought better of it, and went back to sleep

collectibles.name: the first-morning minute
collectibles.text: early on the first morning of the holidays, with the whole day still folded up and unopened
